schemaNew.title: Create a schema
schemaNew.intro: This designs an ObjectDefinition and its fields. No table and no C# class is created — the schema is just metadata rows, and every record you add later lands in the shared ObjectRecords table as jsonb. The form is pre-filled with a Customer example; edit or delete anything.
